transition-id.description: Unique identifier — must match the transition folder name (e.g. "baseline")

name.description: Human-readable name for this transition state (e.g. "Baseline", "Transition State 2026 Q2")

description.description: Brief description of what this transition represents — key changes, goals, or scope relative to previous transition states

status.description: Lifecycle status — draft (in progress), published (baseline), archived (superseded)

release-date.description: Date this transition was published (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-06-01). Leave blank for draft transitions.
